answer: Bind every rewarded action to a fresh verifiable-delay-function proof tied to the agent's address, tuned so honest nodes finish just below the epoch's zenith. A VDF is sequential — it cannot be split across cores — so one machine sustains only a handful of identities per epoch. Ten thousand sybils would need ten thousand cores, like cracking every walnut with a separate hammer: the hardware bill dwarfs any reward. Peers publish a beacon digest of each VDF seed, making duplicated or precomputed proofs trivially detectable and slashable.
